summary: Iteration 2: Verified the four new enhancements — Stripe payments, waitlist/forgot-password emails, admin image uploads, self-hosted analytics — plus admin/account extensions. Backend: 20/22 pytest tests passed, 2 skipped due to a real observability bug (email logs not visible). Frontend: Stripe redirect, /payment/success, /payment/cancel, /account cards, admin Analytics tab (renders live totals + top products + daily chart), admin upload controls on product modal, and page_view analytics on route changes — all verified working.

minor.issue: The 'console' email provider uses logging.getLogger('trillion.email').info(...) but no logger config is set up, so under uvicorn the effective level is WARNING and NO [email:console] line is ever emitted to stdout/stderr. The endpoints still return 200 and the background task technically runs, but there is no observable evidence emails were queued. The spec explicitly asks for a '[email:console] line with correct product name' in the backend log — that log line is currently missing. Same for the 'password reset' log line from /api/auth/forgot-password (logger 'trillion' also not configured). Fix: add `logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)` in server.py, or explicitly setLevel(INFO) on `trillion.*` loggers, or switch to `print()` for the console provider.

Brute-force lockout still keyed on email only (identifier = 'email:...') — this works correctly for account lockout, verified 429 does trigger with 6 wrong attempts on same email. So iteration-1 bug is FIXED. (Confirmed indirectly: server.py line 519 now shows `identifier = f'email:{email}'`.)

action_items: Configure logging so `trillion.email` and `trillion` loggers emit at INFO level under uvicorn — otherwise the 'console' email provider is silently a no-op (log-wise) and forgot-password reset links are invisible in dev/preview. Simplest fix: add `logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)` near the top of /app/backend/server.py, or add a `logging.getLogger('trillion').setLevel(logging.INFO)` after the logger declaration.
critical_code_review_comments: enhancements.py stripe_webhook: catches only SignatureVerificationError; if construct_event raises ValueError (invalid JSON body) it will bubble to the catch-all 500 handler instead of 400. Minor.
enhancements.py get_upload: does not verify upload_id shape → arbitrary strings hit Mongo. Not a security bug but consider a length/regex guard.
enhancements.py analytics events endpoint accepts unknown event names silently (per design), but silently drops props > 2000 chars without any signal — fine for hardening.
email_service._send_console uses `logger.info` with no logging config, so emails are invisible in preview logs (see minor issue above).
server.py forgot_password uses `logger.info` on module logger `trillion` which has no handlers/level configured — invisible in preview.

seed_products still uses `$setOnInsert` on all fields (good — admin edits preserved) except the code sets `updated_at`/`created_at` inside the doc that only lands via $setOnInsert, so on subsequent restarts existing products keep their original timestamps (fine, intended).
server.py is now ~770 lines with enhancements imported — still fine, but the split into /backend/enhancements.py is a good pattern; consider extending to auth/products routers.
SEED_PRODUCTS stripe_lookup_key is set at runtime by setup_stripe.py, not in code — verified via mongo (appforge → appforge_monthly). Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Stripe redirect, /payment/success, /payment/cancel, /account, admin analytics tab, admin upload controls, page_view analytics — all verified)

rca of the issue: Symptom: The two skipped tests (test_waitlist_triggers_email_and_is_idempotent, test_forgot_password_logs) cannot observe the required '[email:console]' or 'password reset' log lines in /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log. RCA: email_service.py line 31 uses `logger.info('[email:console] ...')` on `logging.getLogger('trillion.email')`, and server.py line 587 uses `logger.info('[password reset] issued for %s', email)` on `logging.getLogger('trillion')`. Neither logger has a handler or level set, so they inherit from root (which under uvicorn has effective level WARNING for application loggers). Therefore `.info(...)` calls are dropped before any handler sees them. The endpoints still succeed (return 200) and the background send_email task still returns True, but there is zero observability. Mitigation: add `logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)` at the top of server.py (before FastAPI init), OR add `logging.getLogger('trillion').setLevel(logging.INFO)` — a one-line fix. Verified by grepping backend.out.log after multiple waitlist/forgot-password calls: 0 matches for 'email:console' or 'password reset'.
